descriptionHtml: The IEEE Electronic Design Competition, organized annually by the IEEE Sri Lanka Section, is a prestigious and highly anticipated event that shines a spotlight on innovation, creativity, and technical prowess in the field of electronic design and engineering. This event primarily caters to university students and serves as a platform for them to showcase their talents and ingenuity.
